progress.runtimeColorReadabilityLimit: Dark fur detail limited in production low/medium frames; paired same-pose normal attachments plus detailed raw face/body views resolve deformation inspection. No claim that black production color readability is improved.

limits: All thirteen clips sampled at six phases with full face/body and opposite head sides; final runtime sixteen states at six phases in source/battle at low/medium; nine equipped techniques at twelve times front/side; advancing 24-frame companion idle and all 16 atlas cells. Cinder production fur remains dark: paired same-pose normal attachments and lit raw views establish deformation review, not improved production color readability. Existing tiny Polar foreign-paw smoothing weight and scalar amplitude flags remain quantified in prior evidence and regression tests. No invented hind-leg death motion. Main/live delivery pending.
